hydra_schema.notes:
Data limits:
This state is enforced by the IOT team. This is the common printer state across all 3D Systems Printer. Needed to standardize basic minimum printer states across all printers.
PRINTER_STATE_INITIALIZING,
PRINTER_STATE_IDLE ,
PRINTER_STATE_PREPARING,
PRINTER_STATE_BUILDING,
PRINTER_STATE_PAUSED,
PRINTER_STATE_ABORTED,
PRINTER_STATE_COMPLETED,
PRINTER_STATE_BUSY,
Note:
PRINTER_STATE_IDLE - (Printer is available to start new job ,only to be set when old print has been cleared)
PRINTER_STATE_BUSY - (State for anything the printer is busy doing any manual operation/procedure what does not fit in the above states)
